# The DevSec Blueprint

> Structured DevSecOps and Cloud Security mastery. Built through real systems, not theory.

The DevSec Blueprint is a learning platform that provides hands-on curriculum, courses, and walkthroughs for DevSecOps and Cloud Security engineering. It covers topics across AWS, Azure, GCP, application security, and DevOps practices.

## Site Info

- URL: https://devsecblueprint.com
- Publisher: DevSec Blueprint LLC
- Contact: https://devsecblueprint.com/about/contact
- Discord: https://discord.gg/enMmUNq8jc
- GitHub: https://github.com/devsecblueprint/devsecblueprint
- License: PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://devsecblueprint.com/): Landing page with platform overview
- [Courses](https://devsecblueprint.com/courses): Available DevSecOps and Cloud Security courses
- [Curriculum](https://devsecblueprint.com/curriculum): Structured learning paths and curriculum overview

- [Contact](https://devsecblueprint.com/about/contact): Contact information
- [Sponsorships](https://devsecblueprint.com/sponsorships): Sponsorship opportunities

## Topics Covered

- DevSecOps pipelines and practices
- Cloud Security (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Application Security (AppSec)
- Security Engineering
- Infrastructure as Code security
- CI/CD security integration
- Container and Kubernetes security
- Threat modeling and secure architecture

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- Backend: FastAPI (Python)
- Infrastructure: AWS (CDK / Terraform)
- Deployment: GitHub Actions CI/CD
